reviews.comment: i took her class this summer and it was easy to understand. i failed the class before so it was a kinda relieving that she was accessible/helpful. most of the people failing didn't show up all summer. they litterally dgaf. If you just go to ask for help on an assignment she will basically get to a 100. we got a pizza party too, so that was cool.

reviews.comment: Professor Gonzalez was a great professor and cared about each student. You did need to come to every class, but if you just skimmed the reading, you'd be fine. No tests, but 2 group projects. Easy grader if you do all the assignments. Would recommend taking if you need any credit. Easy to reach as well.
